tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List every database engine and version sqlize.online can run SQL on, with the sql_version id to pass to other tools. Preloaded sample databases are marked and come with data; all others start empty.

tools.name: run_sql
tools.description: Run a SQL script on a real database engine and return every result set and error. The database is fresh and empty (unless sql_version is a preloaded sample) and is dropped after the run, so include the CREATE TABLE and INSERT statements the queries need. Separate statements with semicolons. Results

tools.name: describe_database
tools.description: Show the tables, columns and foreign keys of a preloaded sample database, so queries against it can use the real names.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: Save a SQL script on sqlize.online without running it and return a link where anyone can open, run and edit it. run_sql already returns such a link for the script it ran.
